| # Object 0x1003 pre-defined error field with last occurred errors {#object-0x1003-pre-defined-error-field-with-last-occurred-errors-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                        |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This object holds errors that have occurred on the device and have been signaled via an emergency object.

It is an error history. Writing to sub-index 0 deletes the entire error history.

  Index       0x1003
  ----------- -------------------------
  Name        Pre-defined Error Field
  Object      ARRAY
  Data Type   UNSIGNED 32
  Category    Optional

 

 

SubIndex Supported

  SubIndex        0
  --------------- ------------------
  Description     Number of Errors
  Access          RW
  Value Range     UNSINGNED8
  Default Value   0x0
  PDO Mapping     No

 

 

  SubIndex        01-10
  --------------- ----------------------
  Description     Standard Error Field
  Access          RO
  Value Range     UNSIGNED 32
  Default Value   0x00000000
  PDO Mapping     No

 

 

  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ![Info](info.png){style="margin:0;width:2.1667in;height:0.6979in;border:none"}   This object supports up to 10 entries. A new error is always entered in subindex 1. Before this occurs, however, any existing errors are moved down in the list by one position. In the event of more than 10 errors, the first errors are lost! The error messages are not stored in the persistent memory (NVM), i.e. they are lost when the device is switched off. refer to bds_canopen_emcySend for more details.
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
